title: Best Ferocious Fruit E-Liquids | 70/30 Bundle
description:
Best-Selling Fruit Flavours Bundle:
If you love exotic fruit flavors, then you’re going to love this Ferocious Fruit Bundle-in 70/30 shortfills
!
Only including the most popular, best-selling vape juices from Ferocious, this fruity bundle comes nicotine-free, 3mg nicotine strength, or 6mg nicotine strength for every kind of vaper!
Berrylicious Ice :A vibrant combination of strawberries, blackberries, raspberries, and cherries and a blast of Arctic ice!
Dragonberry: Sweet flavor of raspberries and blueberries combined with exotic dragon fruit
Banana Mango Apricot: Luscious blend of mellow peach, sweet mango and creamy banana
Blue-bomb: Flavour-packed blue raspberry base, candy sweetness, and a touch of cooling
Strawberry Watermelon kiwi:ucculent medley of tropical fruits and summer berries.
Mango Pineaple Papaya
: Enjoy the sweet, succulent combination of mango, pineapple and papaya
Fruity Menthol: Fruity explosion of mixed berries and a blast of icy menthol
Mango Guava Ice:
Sweet tropical mash-up cooled with ice!
Mixed Fruit Ice:
Tropical icy explosion of mixed red berries and lychee
Our Ferocious Flavours fruit e-liquid bundle offers 4 bottles of delicious sweet treats designed to tantalise your taste-buds. Made from 70/30 vape juice, utilising a 70vg & 30pg ratio this liquid is perfectly suited to sub-ohm devices.
Available in nicotine-free 0mg and 3mg nicotine. Pick between nic salts or freebase nicotine to create your desired vaping experience.
Nic salts provide a smooth throat hit and an immediate nicotine release, while freebase provides a stronger throat hit and a more gradual release.
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
